name: Toilet
description: A standard white porcelain toilet bolted to the floor, tank against the wall, chrome flush lever worn shiny in the middle. The seat is the cheap open-front commercial kind, and the water level sits suspiciously high, like it's always one flush from making a point.

params.success_message: You relieve yourself. Ah, much better.
Porcelain, tank, lever. It has witnessed things no employee is paid enough to scrub, yet it stands ready. A hero, really.
